items.text: Keenan Allen downgraded OUT (groin) vs Commanders; Mike Evans GTD (ribs) but intends to play through it; Lamar Jackson ACTIVE/off IR report.
items.why: Groin for Allen; ribs for Evans (compression plan); back cleared for Jackson.
items.implication: Colts WR depth hit; Evans risky start; Jackson full go.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after missing time with hip injury; returns vs Eagles.
items.why: Cleared injury report, full participant Friday.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns but monitor for snap limits.
items.opportunity: Primary target share in Rams offense
corroboration: Sarah Barshop reports will play possibly limited

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent matchup vs Cowboys.
items.why: Off injury report after limited practices.
items.implication: Elite WR1 spot with high implied total.
items.opportunity: High target volume vs weak DvP

items.why: Missed all practice with ankle injury.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Vikings offense.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell.
items.implication: Concentrated targets to Garrett Wilson; RB work to backups.
items.opportunity: Wilson target share spike; Braelon Allen carries

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert OUT for Eagles vs Rams; also Hollywood Brown.
items.implication: Eagles offense severely depleted without three key players including Baun.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for remaining Eagles WRs/TEs like Wicks or others; worse overall attack.

items.text: Nacua return great but possible snap limits; Collins excellent DvP vs Cowboys (inflate WR 7.3%) with Texans high implied total.
items.why: Speculation on Nacua limits; data-backed Collins spot.
items.implication: Start both confidently, watch Nacua volume.
items.opportunity: Collins high-end WR1; Nacua solid but capped?

items.text: McConkey LP-DNP-LP foot trend concerning (prior rib); Addison big opportunity home vs weak secondary with Jefferson out; Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun.
items.why: Practice trend for McConkey; usage vacuum for Addison; key absences for PHI.
items.implication: Fade/caution McConkey; smash Addison; lower Eagles stack confidence.
items.opportunity: Addison routes/targets spike; reverse PHI pass catcher values.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Zach Charbonnet also OUT.
items.why: Chest injury after tough early season.
items.opportunity: More work to remaining backs like Kenneth Walker if available or others.
Jaylen Wright and others elevated for carries/targets.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow) again; Rachaad White also OUT.
items.opportunity: Potential bump to remaining skill players if any.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week, Dowdle out, great vs CLE allowing 88+ rush yds every game. Also LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, high util, vs NYG soft vs RB).
items.why: Workhorse usage + matchup for Warren; volume surge for Love.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low 42% snaps, 3.5% targets, poor SEA matchup). LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS w/ Penix, vs NO), Garrett Wilson (36% TS w/ Mitchell out), Josh Downs (31% TS, RZ, vs WAS), George Kittle (rising share, Evans GTD).
items.why: Usage collapse + tough run D for Hampton; target share + matchups for loves.
items.implication: Sit Hampton; start the LOVEs as WR2/TE1.
items.opportunity: Wilson benefits from Hall/Mitchell outs; Kittle if Evans limited.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough start: lost GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back practicing. Still eye-test passes, long-term intact.
items.implication: Short-term fade even if healthy; monitor ROS.
